# Write your MySQL query statement below
WITH
    P AS (
        SELECT
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER () AS id,
            x,
            y
        FROM Coordinates
    )
SELECT DISTINCT
    p1.x,
    p1.y
FROM
    P AS p1
    JOIN P AS p2 ON p1.x = p2.y AND p1.y = p2.x AND p1.x <= p1.y AND p1.id != p2.id
ORDER BY 1, 2;
title: Symmetric Coordinates
